_comment: Worked example. Each task feeds a findings.json to the gh-export skill and rule-judges the produced GitHub-issue markdown. reviewed:true is REQUIRED for --backend claude replay. All checks are local (no judge API). See skill-training/README.md.

tasks.intent: Convert this findings.json into a copy-pasteable GitHub issue markdown block using the gh-export output template.
tasks.context_excerpt:
findings.json:
[{"id":"F-01","title":"SQL injection in /api/reports export","severity":"critical","component":"GET /api/reports?sort=","description":"The sort parameter is concatenated directly into an ORDER BY clause.","evidence":"sort=id)--%20 returns full table; sort=(SELECT%20version()) leaks DB version","reproduction":{"command":"curl 'https://target/api/reports?sort=id);SELECT%20pg_sleep(5)--'"},"remediation":{"diff":"- order_by(request.args['sort'])\n+ order_by(ALLOWED_SORTS[request.args['sort']])","file":"api/reports.py","line":88,"verification":"Same payload now returns HTTP 400 invalid sort key","references":["https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/89.html"],"effort":"low","breaking_change":false}}]
tasks.reference: A well-formed gh-export issue block with concrete impact, reproduction, and a remediation section.

tasks.intent: Format this findings.json entry as a GitHub issue markdown block following the gh-export template.
tasks.context_excerpt:
findings.json:
[{"id":"F-02","title":"Reflected XSS in search box","severity":"high","component":"GET /search?q=","description":"The q parameter is reflected into the page without HTML-encoding.","evidence":"q=<script>alert(document.domain)</script> executes","reproduction":{"command":"open 'https://target/search?q=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C/script%3E'"},"remediation":{"diff":"- innerHTML = q\n+ textContent = q","file":"web/search.js","line":42,"verification":"Payload renders as inert text","references":["https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/79.html"],"effort":"low","breaking_change":false}}]
tasks.reference: A gh-export issue block for a reflected XSS finding, severity High.

tasks.intent: Produce the gh-export GitHub issue markdown for this IDOR finding from findings.json.
tasks.context_excerpt:
findings.json:
[{"id":"F-03","title":"IDOR on invoice download","severity":"high","component":"GET /invoices/{id}/pdf","description":"Any authenticated user can fetch any invoice by incrementing the numeric id; no ownership check.","evidence":"User A (id 1001) fetches /invoices/2002/pdf belonging to User B and receives 200 + PDF","reproduction":{"command":"curl -H 'Cookie: session=A' https://target/invoices/2002/pdf -o leaked.pdf"},"remediation":{"diff":"+ if invoice.owner_id != current_user.id: abort(403)","file":"api/invoices.py","line":120,"verification":"Cross-user id now returns 403","references":["https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/639.html"],"effort":"low","breaking_change":false}}]
tasks.reference: A gh-export issue block for an IDOR finding with a self-contained reproduction command.

tasks.intent: Convert this findings.json entry (no remediation field) into a gh-export GitHub issue markdown block; the Remediation section must be omitted when there is no remediation.
tasks.context_excerpt:
findings.json:
[{"id":"F-04","title":"Missing Content-Security-Policy header","severity":"low","component":"https://target/ (all responses)","description":"Responses do not set a Content-Security-Policy header, weakening defense-in-depth against XSS.","evidence":"curl -I https://target/ shows no CSP header"}]
tasks.reference: A gh-export issue block for a low-severity finding with NO remediation section (the skill omits ## Remediation when the finding has no remediation field).

tasks.intent: Format this findings.json entry as a GitHub issue markdown block using the gh-export template.

[{"id":"F-05","title":"Verbose error leaks stack trace","severity":"medium","component":"POST /api/checkout","description":"Unhandled exceptions return a full stack trace including file paths and library versions.","evidence":"Sending a malformed body returns a 500 with a Python traceback and app path /srv/app/checkout.py","remediation":{"diff":"+ app.config['PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS'] = False","file":"app.py","line":15,"verification":"Malformed body now returns a generic 500 JSON error","references":["https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/209.html"],"effort":"low","breaking_change":false}}]
